AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Pest and Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Pest and Disease Control.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Harvesting and Storage? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Harvesting and Storage.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Harvesting and Storage.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water Harvesting and Storage.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Harvesting and Storage.

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen and Backyard Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen? (1 mark)

   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.

   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation Measures.

17. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving animal products? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving animal products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving animal products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving animal products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving animal products.

19. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparation of Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparation of Animal Products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparation of Animal Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparation of Animal Products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preparation of Animal Products.

21. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

22. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously
